plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Per-repo project memory: auto-injects PROJECT_MEMORY.md into context each session and captures durable facts with /project-memory:memo, so you never re-explain a project.

plugins.name: code-to-lottie
plugins.description: Convert tagged SVG + CSS-keyframe animations to true-vector Lottie JSON (bodymovin) with three-stage verification: keyframe-timing diff, geometry round-trip, and a >=99% browser pixel-diff against the source.
